**Depends on:** None.

`sun secret set` targets `sun-secrets` but standard Deployment pods mount `<service>-secrets` — POSTGRES_URL is never injected

**Description:** `sun secret set --env <env> <KEY> <VALUE>` patches a Kubernetes Secret named `sun-secrets` in each workspace namespace. However, standard `Deployment` resources generated by `sun up` mount `<service>-secrets` (e.g., `notify-worker-secrets`, `charge-svc-secrets`) via `envFrom: secretRef`. The `sun-secrets` object is only referenced by Argo Rollout resources (`rollout_doc` in `sun_cli_manifest.ml`). For the default golden path (no progressive delivery), `sun-secrets` is never mounted in any pod. Running `sun secret set` prints "secret set in 2 namespace(s)" with no indication that the secret is silently ignored by all running pods.

**Impact:** A first-time user follows the Tutorial, runs `sun secret set --env local POSTGRES_URL <url>`, and sees a success message. After `sun up` and pod restart, `POSTGRES_URL` is still empty in every pod. `notify_worker` falls through to `| None -> ack (); Ok ()` — every Kafka event is silently consumed without writing to the DB. `GET /notifications` returns `[]` indefinitely with no error. The Kafka-to-DB write path is completely broken and the failure is invisible.

**Remediation:** Option A (recommended): In `sun_cli_secret.ml` `set`, discover the list of `<service>-secrets` objects in each target namespace via `kubectl get secrets -n <ns> -o name` (or derive from workspace manifest), and patch each one instead of (or in addition to) `sun-secrets`. This preserves per-service secret isolation. Option B: Add `sun-secrets` as a second `- secretRef` entry in `deployment_doc` alongside `<service>-secrets`, making `sun secret set` work as designed for all workload types. Option A requires no manifest change and is safer.

**Code locations:**
- `cli/sun/lib/sun_cli_secret.ml` line 84: `kubectl apply` targets `Sun_cli_manifest.runtime_secret_name` (`"sun-secrets"`)
- `cli/sun/lib/sun_cli_manifest.ml` lines 303–304: `deployment_doc` `envFrom` mounts `<name>-secrets`
- `cli/sun/lib/sun_cli_manifest.ml` lines 408–409: `rollout_doc` `envFrom` mounts `runtime_secret_name` (`"sun-secrets"`) — only Argo Rollout workloads consume `sun-secrets`
